properties.title: Marine Weather Statement issued October 4 at 11:53PM CDT by NWS Mobile AL
properties.description:
At 1152 PM CDT...A line of strong thunderstorms was located along a
line extending from East Santa Rosa Sound to 50 nm southwest of
Oriskany Reef...moving east at 15 knots.

Locations impacted include...
Mary Esther, Navarre Beach, Fort Walton Beach, East Santa Rosa Sound,
Oriskany Reef, Okaloosa Deep Water Reef, Shalimar, Fort Walton
Liberty Ship Reef, Destin, and East Bay.

The primary threats from these storms are wind gusts up to 30
knots...locally higher waves...and heavy downpours. Boaters should
consider seeking safe harbor until these storms have passed.

Weather conditions support the development of waterspouts.
Waterspouts can easily overturn boats and create locally hazardous
waves and seas. If a waterspout is sighted...seek safe harbor
immediately.

These storms may continue to intensify and a warning may soon be
needed. Please continue to monitor local radio or TV for further
National Weather Service updates or possible warnings.

To report severe weather...call (800) 284-9059.
